definitions.explanation: An umbrella designed to provide shade from the sun, typically used by women.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Parasols are commonly used in Japan, especially by women concerned about sun damage and skin protection. Recently, men's parasols (⟦{男性用|だんせいよう}→男性用：noentry⟧{日傘|ひがさ}) have also become more accepted due to extreme summer heat.
